footer.disclaimer: Nexim uses machine-learning algorithms to analyze immigration rules and labor markets in real time. We provide a statistical probability of success, helping you save hundreds of hours of independent legal research. The result is an expert estimate, not a legal guarantee.
footer.footerLegalDisclaimer: Nexim provides automated, general information based on AI analysis. It does not constitute legal, tax, or immigration advice. For decisions about your individual case, please consult a qualified lawyer or licensed immigration advisor.

legal.termsDisclaimerOfLiabilityBody: Nexim is an informational and analytical tool. Any outputs—including AI-generated assessments, country suggestions, and reports—are non-binding estimates based solely on the information you provide and on automated processing. They do not constitute legal, immigration, tax, or employment advice and are not a substitute for qualified professionals or official government information. You use Nexim and any results entirely at your own risk. To the fullest extent permitted by applicable law, Nexim and its operators disclaim liability for decisions you make or losses you incur in connection with the service.
legal.termsAiDataConsentBody: Certain features rely on artificial intelligence. By proceeding, you acknowledge that the answers and related profile information you submit may be transmitted to Google's Gemini API (and, where applicable, to other subprocessors such as Supabase for storage) for analysis and report generation. Processing is limited to providing and improving the service described on nexim.world. You confirm that you are entitled to share the information you submit. Do not submit highly sensitive categories of personal data unless you accept that such data may be processed as described. For more detail, see our full Privacy Policy.
legal.termsP_aiInformational: AI analysis results are for information only and do not constitute official legal advice.

They are intended to help you explore options and prepare next steps; they are not a substitute for your own judgment or professional advice.

legal.privacyP_intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Nexim (nexim.world) processes personal data when you use our website and services. We are committed to protecting your privacy and to compliance with the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR / DSGVO), including lawful processing, data minimisation, and your statutory rights.
legal.privacyP_collect: We collect questionnaire responses (including profile, preferences, and relocation-related answers), account data such as your email address when you register or pay, technical data typically collected on websites (for example IP address and browser type), and payment-related metadata from our payment processors. We do not store full payment card numbers on our own servers.
legal.privacyP_email: We collect your email address when you request to receive your analysis results. Your email is used only to send your results and, with your consent, relocation-related materials. We do not share your email with third parties. You may unsubscribe at any time.
legal.privacyH2_processing: How we use your data (Supabase and Gemini)
legal.privacyP_processing: Questionnaire data is processed using the Google Gemini API and stored in Supabase. We use it to generate personalized AI analyses and reports. Text and structured answers are sent to Google's Gemini API for analysis; processing is performed server-side so API keys are not exposed in your browser. We do not sell your personal data.
legal.privacyP_legalBasis: Where GDPR applies, we may rely on: performance of a contract (providing the service you requested); consent where we ask for it; legitimate interests in operating, securing, and improving our services, balanced against your rights; and compliance with legal obligations.
legal.privacyP_retention: We keep assessment and account data only as long as needed to provide the service, meet legal requirements, and resolve disputes. You may request deletion where applicable law allows, subject to statutory retention duties.
legal.privacyP_rights: Depending on applicable law, you may have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict or object to processing, request data portability, and lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. Contact us through nexim.world to exercise these rights where applicable.
legal.privacyP_transfers: Our service providers (such as Supabase and Google) may process data in the European Economic Area, the United States, or other countries. Where required, we use appropriate safeguards, including Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission.
legal.privacyP_contact: For privacy-related requests, please contact us via the channels listed on nexim.world.
legal.cookiesP_intro: This Cookie Policy describes how nexim.world uses cookies and similar technologies when you visit our site.
legal.cookiesP_essential: We use strictly necessary cookies and similar storage that are required for the website to work. This includes cookies used by Supabase Auth for secure login (for example magic-link sessions). These technologies are essential to maintain your session and are used without consent where EU law treats them as strictly necessary.
legal.cookiesP_analytics: We may use a limited set of analytics cookies or similar tools to understand aggregate usage (such as traffic patterns and technical errors) and to improve reliability and performance. Where analytics are not strictly necessary, we will ask for your consent where required by law.
legal.cookiesP_manage: You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings. Blocking essential cookies may prevent sign-in, checkout, or other core features from working correctly.
legal.cookiesP_more: For details on how we process personal data, please read our Privacy Policy.

result.borderHint: Tap each line when you have verified it against the rules of your destination.
borderItems: Personal belongings: declare goods above duty-free allowances; keep receipts for high-value items.
Cash & instruments: know the per-person cash limit; declare bank drafts, precious metals, and crypto keys if asked.
Medicines: carry originals, prescriptions, and translated doctor letters; check controlled-substance rules.
Electronics: laptops, tablets, and phones may need to power on; remove sensitive data or use travel devices.
Prohibited & restricted: meats, plants, seeds, aerosols, drones—verify customs lists before packing.
Documents: passport, visa, work/study letters, insurance, and accommodation proof in carry-on only.
